# Rajkot.blog

> Independent English-language local news and practical city guides covering Rajkot, Gujarat, India, and nearby destinations.

News reports identify their sources. Travel and food guides may include published visitor information and illustrative photographs; check dates, captions and official sources for current details. The website does not offer a booking API or agent-callable tools.

## Main resources

- [Homepage](https://rajkot.blog/): Featured stories and city guides.
- [All articles](https://rajkot.blog/articles/): News, travel, food, education and business coverage.
- [XML sitemap](https://rajkot.blog/sitemap.xml): Discover published pages.

## Popular guides

- [Places to visit in Rajkot](https://rajkot.blog/articles/best-places-to-visit-in-rajkot.html): City attractions and nearby excursions.
- [Famous foods of Rajkot](https://rajkot.blog/articles/famous-foods-of-rajkot.html): Regional dishes and snacks.
- [Cafés in Rajkot](https://rajkot.blog/articles/cafes-in-rajkot-guide.html): Sourced café information.
